messages:
maria_sales: Heads-up — Orpheus (partner) requested a co-sell shared POC: Dedicated in their AWS account via VPC peering, SAML SSO, customer-managed KMS/HSM, telemetry to their Splunk, and a pricing sketch for bursty events. Can we do a 20-30m technical handoff tomorrow? cc @ivan_partner

ivan_partner: Thanks Maria. Must-haves: data residency in partner VPC, EU (Frankfurt) primary, p90 latency <=150ms for single-turn chat. Typical ctx ~512 tokens; occasional 2048 token spikes. They want per-tenant audit logs and per-route telemetry.

josh_se: I can own presales. Quick clarifiers: expected sustained QPS vs burst concurrency? Are they okay with a warmed KV cache? Proposed two-phase plan: (1) sandbox — 1 small GPU pool + hosted fallback, (2) pilot — 3 reserved GPUs, tenant KV caching, canary routing. Deliverables: ASCII topology, SAML flow, egress/egress IP plan, k6/curl load snippet, security questionnaire answers.

maria_sales: They indicated baseline ~15 qps and peak ~200 concurrent users for the first month. Warmers are fine; they expect p90 <150ms.

priya_eng: Ops/pricing notes: Recommend 3-month pilot with a small reserve (50% commit) + burst credits billed usage with 20% partner discount for the pilot. Provisioning lead time for dedicated pool ~8 business days; we can stage with hosted fallback for immediate tests. Telemetry: we can stream aggregated token usage, p50/p90 latency histograms, and sampled traces to their Splunk collector (no raw PII). We'll provide a telemetry schema + sampling guide.

ivan_partner: Security questionnaire landed — they need SOC2 mappings, control descriptions, and confirmation that keys can be HSM-backed and customer-managed. Also want network diagram showing egress and audit log flows.

eng-security-bot: Confirm: customer-managed KMS/HSM supported for Private/Dedicated deployments. SOC2 pack available; eng-security will review the vendor questionnaire and respond in 48h.

josh_se: I'll draft the small runbook for canary rollouts and a minimal load harness by EOD. Example quick test: curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"rwd-large-v1","input":"Summarize this","max_tokens":256}'

priya_eng: I'll prepare the pricing sketch, tenancy diagram, and attach the SOC2 cover memo.

maria_sales: Plan: 1) Kickoff call tomorrow 09:30 PT — propose? 2) Josh: load harness + ASCII topology by EOD. 3) Priya: pricing + security packet by EOD. 4) Ivan: confirm partner CIDR, Splunk endpoint, and SSO contact.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Orpheus co-sell POC kickoff" 2026-03-24 09:30 PT. Invites: maria_sales, josh_se, priya_eng, ivan_partner, eng-security-bot.

maria_sales: Thanks — I'll convert notes into a 1-page runbook and share before the call. :thumbsup:
